implementation.targetScope: Bounded synchronous count/size LRU caches used by Babel compilation targets, CSS parsing, DOM selector caching and path-scurry. Includes lazy TTL, stale-read controls, disposal, recency iteration and default-constructor compatibility for Babel max/get/set. Async fetch/memo, TTL autopurge, unbounded TTL-only caches, dump/load, status instrumentation, internal storage APIs and legacy v5 APIs beyond the actual Babel caller are outside scope.
